title: [review] rtc_rx8130ce set_time: no input validation, 1 << tm_wday UB for -1/>31
description: P2. rtc_rx8130ce.c:150+94: wday2rtc computes 1 << wday; struct rtc_time.tm_wday documented domain includes -1 (unknown) and is int -> 1 << -1 is UB, >31 also UB; out-of-range sec/min/hour/day/mon produce invalid BCD written to the chip. Inherited verbatim from upstream 4.1 but the RTC API documents field ranges so the driver should validate and return -EINVAL. Fix: range-check all fields incl tm_wday>=0, clamp/reject, return -EINVAL.
